## Installing tidyverse package
```{r}
library (tidyverse)
library(gt)
```


## Exercise 1 - using rep()
```{r}
# by specifying arguments in order
print(rep(5, 7))
```

```{r}
# by using argument names
print (rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```

## Exercise 2 - Variable Types
```{r}
# assigning variables
a_string <- "Hello world!"
an_integer <- 5
a_boolean <- TRUE

#printing class of variables
print(class(a_string))
print(class(an_integer))
print(class(a_boolean))
```

## Exercise 3 - Vectors
```{r}
# Assigning variables
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

# moving into vector
cell_id = c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated_bool = c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_cells_before = c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
n_cells_after = c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)

print(cell_id)
print(treated_bool)
print(n_cells_before)
print(n_cells_after)
```

## Exercise 4 - Accessing Elements of a Vector
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
print(all_my_pets[4])
```

## Exercise 5 - Data Frames
```{r}
# Assigning variables
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

# moving into vector
cell_id = c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated_bool = c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_cells_before = c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
n_cells_after = c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)

my_data_frame <- tibble (
  id = cell_id,
  treated = treated_bool,
  num_cells_before = n_cells_before,
  num_cells_after = n_cells_after,
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
